74000.meaning1: delighted with the wearing away of craving; taking pleasure in the depletion of desire
74000.commentary: (DHPa) taṇhakkhayarato'ti arahatte c'eva nibbāne ca abhirato hoti, taṃ patthayamāno viharati. (JAa) taṇhakkhayarato'ti nibbānarato. nibbānañ'hi āgamma taṇhā khīyati, tasmā taṃ taṇhakkhayo'ti vuccati. tattha rato hoti abhirato. sammāsambuddhasāvako'ti buddhassa savanante jāto bahussuto yog'āvacarapuggalo.

examples.text: api dibbesu kāmesu, ratiṃ so n'ādhigacchati, taṇhakkhayarato hoti, sammāsambuddhasāvako.

74001.meaning1: who has surmounted mental proliferation; who has transcended endless conceptualization

examples.text: pūj'ārahe pūjayato, buddhe yadi va sāvake, papañcasamatikkante, tiṇṇasokapariddave.

74002.meaning1: like the aggregates; like the conglomeration of mind and matter
74002.commentary: (DHPa) khandhasamā'ti khandhehi samā. yathā parihariyamānā khandhā dukkhā, evaṃ aññaṃ dukkhaṃ nāma n'atthi.

examples.text: n'atthi rāgasamo aggi, n'atthi dosasamo kali, n'atthi khandhā'disā dukkhā, n'atthi santiparaṃ sukhaṃ.

74003.commentary: (DHPa) jighacchāparamā rogā'ti yasmā añño rogo sakiṃ tikicchito vinassati vā tadaṅgavasena vā pahīyati, jighacchā pana niccakālaṃ tikicchitabbā'y'evā'ti sesarogānaṃ ayaṃ paramā nāma.

examples.text: jighacchāparamā rogā, saṅkhāraparamā dukhā, etaṃ ñatvā yathābhūtaṃ, nibbānaṃ paramaṃ sukhaṃ.

74005.commentary: (DHPa) jighacchāparamā rogā'ti yasmā añño rogo sakiṃ tikicchito vinassati vā tadaṅgavasena vā pahīyati, jighacchā pana niccakālaṃ tikicchitabbā'y'evā'ti sesarogānaṃ ayaṃ paramā nāma. saṅkhārā'ti pañca khandhā.

examples.text: jighacchāparamā rogā, saṅkhāraparamā dukhā, etaṃ ñatvā yathābhūtaṃ, nibbānaṃ paramaṃ sukhaṃ.

74006.commentary: (DHPa) santuṭṭhiparamaṃ dhanan'ti gihino vā pabbajitassa vā yaṃ attanā laddhaṃ attano santakaṃ, ten'eva tussanabhāvo santuṭṭhī nāma sesadhanehi paramaṃ dhanaṃ.

examples.text: ārogyaparamā lābhā, santuṭṭhiparamaṃ dhanaṃ, vissāsaparamā ñāti, nibbānaṃ paramaṃ sukhaṃ.

74007.commentary: (DHPa) vissāsaparamā ñātī'ti mātā vā hotu pitā vā, yena saddhiṃ vissāso n'atthi, so aññātako'va. yena aññātakena pana saddhiṃ vissāso atthi, so asambandho'pi paramo uttamo ñāti. tena vuttaṃ, vissāsaparamā ñātī'ti. (JAa) yasmā vissāsaparamā rasā, vissāso paramo uttamo etesan'ti vissāsaparamā rasā. vissāsasadiso hi añño raso nāma n'atthi. avissāsikena hi dinnaṃ catumadhuram'pi vissāsikena dinnaṃ ambilakañjiyaṃ na agghatī'ti.

examples.text: ārogyaparamā lābhā, santuṭṭhiparamaṃ dhanaṃ, vissāsaparamā ñāti, nibbānaṃ paramaṃ sukhaṃ.
sāduṃ vā yadi v'āsāduṃ, appaṃ vā yadi vā bahuṃ, vissattho yattha bhuñjeyya, vissāsaparamā rasā'ti.
tasmā hi dhīraṃ paññañ'ca bahussutañ'ca dhorayhaṃ, sīlaṃ dhutavatam'ariyaṃ taṃ tādisaṃ sappurisaṃ, sumedhaṃ bhajetha nakkhattapathaṃ'va candimā.
ayasā'va malaṃ samuṭṭhitaṃ, taduṭṭhāya tam'eva khādati, evaṃ atidhonacārinaṃ, sakakammāni nayanti duggatiṃ.

74010.meaning1: achieves deep meditation; attains meditative composure

examples.text: dadāti ve yathāsaddhaṃ, yathāpasādanaṃ jano, tattha yo maṅku bhavati, paresaṃ pānabhojane, na so divā vā rattiṃ vā, samādhim'adhigacchati.

74011.meaning1: seeing another's faults; observing the defects of others

examples.text: paravajj'ānupassissa, niccaṃ ujjhānasaññino, āsavā tassa vaḍḍhanti, ārā so āsavakkhayā.

74012.grammar: pr 3rd sg, irreg form of nayati, trans (+acc)
74012.meaning1: draws a conclusion; passes judgement; infers

examples.text: asāhasena dhammena, samena nayatī pare, dhammassa gutto medhāvī, dhammaṭṭho'ti pavuccati.

74013.meaning1: full of desire and greed; avaricious and covetous

examples.text: na muṇḍakena samaṇo, abbato alikaṃ bhaṇaṃ, icchālobhasamāpanno, samaṇo kiṃ bhavissati.
na tena ariyo hoti, yena pāṇāni hiṃsati, ahiṃsā sabbapāṇānaṃ, ariyo'ti pavuccati.

74015.meaning1: mere precepts and practices; just rites and rituals

examples.text: na sīlabbatamattena, bāhusaccena vā pana, atha vā samādhilābhena, vivittasayanena vā.

74016.meaning1: possessing meditative composure; gaining meditation attainments

examples.text: na sīlabbatamattena, bāhusaccena vā pana, atha vā samādhilābhena, vivittasayanena vā.
na sīlabbatamattena, bāhusaccena vā pana, atha vā samādhilābhena, vivittasayanena vā.
na sīlabbatamattena, bāhusaccena vā pana, atha vā samādhilābhena, vivittasayanena vā.
yāva hi vanatho na chijjati, aṇumatto'pi narassa nārisu, paṭibaddhamano'va tāva so, vaccho khīrapāno'va mātari.

74020.meaning1: winter and summer; cold and hot season
74020.commentary: (DHPa) hemantagimhisū'ti hemantagimhesu'pi cattāro māse idañ'c'idañ'ca karonto idh'eva vasissāmī'ti evaṃ diṭṭhadhammikasamparāyikaṃ atthaṃ ajānanto bālo vicinteti.

examples.text: idha vassaṃ vasissāmi, idha hem'antagimhisu, iti bālo vicinteti, antarāyaṃ na bujjhati.

74021.meaning1: besotted with sons and cattle; intoxicated with children and livestock
74021.commentary: (DHPa) taṃ puttapasusammattan'ti taṃ rūpabal'ādisampanne putte ca pasū ca labhitvā mama puttā abhirūpā balasampannā paṇḍitā sabbakiccasamatthā, mama goṇā abhirūpā arogā mahābhāravahā, mama gāvī bahukhīrā'ti evaṃ puttehi ca pasūhi ca sammattaṃ naraṃ.

examples.text: taṃ puttapasusammattaṃ, byāsattamanasaṃ naraṃ, suttaṃ gāmaṃ mah'ogho'va, maccu ādāya gacchati.

74022.meaning1: forsaking a small comfort; giving up a limited happiness

examples.text: mattāsukhapariccāgā, passe ce vipulaṃ sukhaṃ, caje mattāsukhaṃ dhīro, sampassaṃ vipulaṃ sukhaṃ.

74023.meaning1: imposing suffering on others; causing another discomfort

examples.text: paradukkh'ūpadhānena, attano sukham'icchati, verasaṃsaggasaṃsaṭṭho, verā so na parimuccati.
paradukkh'ūpadhānena, attano sukham'icchati, verasaṃsaggasaṃsaṭṭho, verā so na parimuccati.

74025.meaning1: entwined with the entanglement of hatred
74025.commentary: (DHPa) verasaṃsaggasaṃsaṭṭho'ti yo puggalo akkosana-paccakkosana-paharaṇa-paṭiharaṇ'ādīnaṃ vasena aññam'aññaṃ katena verasaṃsaggena saṃsaṭṭho.

examples.text: paradukkh'ūpadhānena, attano sukham'icchati, verasaṃsaggasaṃsaṭṭho, verā so na parimuccati.

74026.meaning1: a traveller who is afflicted with suffering; a wayfarer stricken by pain
74026.commentary: (DHPa) dukkh'ānupatit'addhagū'ti ye vaṭṭasaṅkhātaṃ addhānaṃ paṭipannattā addhagū, te dukkhe anupatitā'va.

examples.text: duppabbajjaṃ durabhiramaṃ, durāvāsā gharā dukhā, dukkhosamānasaṃvāso, dukkh'ānupatit'addhagū, tasmā na c'addhagū siyā, na ca dukkh'ānupatito siyā.

74027.meaning1: famous and wealthy; renowned and rich
74027.commentary: (DHPa) yasobhogasamappito'ti yādiso anāthapiṇḍik'ādīnaṃ pañca-upāsaka-sataparivāra-saṅkhāto āgāriyayaso, tādisen'eva yasena dhanadhaññ'ādiko c'eva sattavidha-ariyadhana-saṅkhāto cā'ti duvidho bhogo, tena samannāgato'ti attho.

examples.text: saddho sīlena sampanno, yasobhogasamappito, yaṃ yaṃ padesaṃ bhajati, tattha tatth'eva pūjito.

74028.meaning1: who commits adultery; who gets involved with another's wife

examples.text: cattāri ṭhānāni naro pamatto, āpajjati paradār'ūpasevī, apuññalābhaṃ na nikāmaseyyaṃ, nindaṃ tatīyaṃ nirayaṃ catutthaṃ.

74029.commentary: (DHPa) na nikāmaseyyan'ti yathā icchati, evaṃ seyyaṃ alabhitvā anicchitaṃ parittakam'eva kālaṃ seyyaṃ labhati.

examples.text: cattāri ṭhānāni naro pamatto, āpajjati paradār'ūpasevī, apuññalābhaṃ na nikāmaseyyaṃ, nindaṃ tatīyaṃ nirayaṃ catutthaṃ.

74030.meaning1: wise person who lives well; clean living sage

examples.text: no ce labhetha nipakaṃ sahāyaṃ, saddhiṃ caraṃ sādhuvihāridhīraṃ, rājā'va raṭṭhaṃ vijitaṃ pahāya, eko care mātaṅg'araññ'eva nāgo.

74031.commentary: (DHPa) so plavatī hurā huran'ti so taṇhāvasiko puggalo bhave bhave uplavati dhāvati.

examples.text: manujassa pamattacārino, taṇhā vaḍḍhati māluvā viya, so plavatī hurā huraṃ, phalam'icchaṃ'va vanasmi vānaro.

74032.meaning1: from here; from this world; from this life
74032.commentary: (DHPa) so plavatī hurā huran'ti so taṇhāvasiko puggalo bhave bhave uplavati dhāvati. (UDa) atha vā hurā huraṃ dhāvati bhantacitto'ti apariññātavitakkattā tannimittānaṃ avijjātaṇhānaṃ vasena paribbhamanamānaso idhalokato paralokaṃ ādānanikkhepehi apar'āparaṃ dhāvati saṃsaratī'ti attho.

examples.text: manujassa pamattacārino, taṇhā vaḍḍhati māluvā viya, so plavatī hurā huraṃ, phalam'icchaṃ'va vanasmi vānaro.
khuddā vitakkā sukhumā vitakkā, anugatā manaso uppilāvā, ete avidvā manaso vitakke, hurā huraṃ dhāvati bhantacitto.

74033.grammar: nt loc sg of vana, irreg form of vanasmiṃ
74033.meaning1: in the wood; in a forest
74033.commentary: (DHPa) phalam'icchaṃ'va vanasmi vānaro, yathā rukkhaphalaṃ icchanto vānaro vanasmiṃ dhāvati, tassa tassa rukkhassa sākhaṃ gaṇhāti, taṃ muñcitvā aññaṃ gaṇhāti, tam'pi muñcitvā aññaṃ gaṇhāti, sākhaṃ alabhitvā sannisinno'ti vattabbataṃ n'āpajjati, evam'eva taṇhāvasiko puggalo hurā huraṃ dhāvanto ārammaṇaṃ alabhitvā taṇhāya apavattaṃ patto'ti vattabbataṃ n'āpajjati.

examples.text: manujassa pamattacārino, taṇhā vaḍḍhati māluvā viya, so plavatī hurā huraṃ, phalam'icchaṃ'va vanasmi vānaro.

74034.meaning1: wanting the fragrant root of vetiver grass
74034.commentary: (DHPa) usīr'attho'va bīraṇaṃ, yathā usīrena atthiko puriso mahantena kudālena bīraṇaṃ khaṇati, evam'assā mūlaṃ khaṇathā'ti attho.

examples.text: taṃ vo vadāmi bhaddaṃ vo, yāvant'ettha samāgatā, taṇhāya mūlaṃ khaṇatha, usīr'attho'va bīraṇaṃ, mā vo naḷaṃ'va soto'va, māro bhañji punappunaṃ.

74035.meaning1: bound fast by bonds and fetters; attached by ties and chains
74035.commentary: (DHPa) saṃyojanasaṅgasattakā'ti dasavidhena saṃyojanasaṅgena c'eva sattavidhena rāgasaṅg'ādinā ca sattā baddhā tasmiṃ vā laggā hutvā.

examples.text: tasiṇāya purakkhatā pajā, parisappanti saso'va bandhito, saṃyojanasaṅgasattakā, dukkham'upenti punappunaṃ cirāya.
tasiṇāya purakkhatā pajā, parisappanti saso'va bandhito, saṃyojanasaṅgasattakā, dukkham'upenti punappunaṃ cirāya.

74037.commentary: (DHPa) dhīrā'ti buddh'ādayo paṇḍitapurisā yaṃ saṅkhalikasaṅkhātaṃ ayasā nibbattaṃ āyasaṃ, andubandhanasaṅkhātaṃ dārujaṃ, yañ'ca pabbajatiṇehi vā aññehi vā vākādīhi rajjuṃ katvā kataṃ rajjubandhanaṃ, taṃ asi-ādīhi chindituṃ sakkuṇeyyabhāvena thiran'ti na vadantī'ti attho.

examples.text: na taṃ daḷhaṃ bandhanam'āhu dhīrā, yadāyasaṃ dārujapabbajañ'ca, sārattarattā maṇikuṇḍalesu, puttesu dāresu ca yā apekkhā.

74038.commentary: (DHPa) sabbadānaṃ dhammadānan'ti sace'pi hi cakkavāḷagabbhe yāva brahmalokā nirantaraṃ katvā sannisinnānaṃ buddha-paccekabuddha-khīṇ'āsavānaṃ kadaligabbhasadisāni cīvarāni dadeyya, tasmiṃ samāgame catuppadikāya gāthāya kat'ānumodanā'va seṭṭhā. tañ'hi dānaṃ tassā gāthāya soḷasiṃ kalaṃ n'āgghati. evaṃ dhammassa desanā'pi vācanam'pi savanam'pi mahantaṃ. yena ca puggalena bahūnaṃ taṃ dhammassavanaṃ kāritaṃ, tass'eva ānisaṃso mahā.

examples.text: sabbadānaṃ dhammadānaṃ jināti, sabbarasaṃ dhammaraso jināti, sabbaratiṃ dhammarati jināti, taṇhakkhayo sabbadukkhaṃ jināti.

74039.commentary: (DHPa) yāpesā puttarati-dhīturati-dhanarati-itthirati-naccagītavādit'ādirati-pabhedā ca anekappabhedā ratī, sā'pi saṃsāravaṭṭe pātetvā dukkh'ānubhavanass'eva paccayo. yā pan'esā dhammaṃ kathentassa vā suṇantassa vā vācentassa vā anto uppajjamānā pīti udaggabhāvaṃ janeti, assūni pavatteti, lomahaṃsaṃ janeti, sāyaṃ saṃsāravaṭṭassa antaṃ katvā arahattapariyosānā hoti. tasmā sabbaratīnaṃ evarūpā dhammarati'y'eva seṭṭhā. tena vuttaṃ, sabbaratiṃ dhammarati jinātī'ti

examples.text: sabbadānaṃ dhammadānaṃ jināti, sabbarasaṃ dhammaraso jināti, sabbaratiṃ dhammarati jināti, taṇhakkhayo sabbadukkhaṃ jināti.

74040.meaning1: foreign book; manuscript from another country

74041.commentary: (DHPa) hatthasaṃyato'ti hatthakīḷāpan'ādīnaṃ vā hatthena paresaṃ paharaṇ'ādīnaṃ vā abhāvena hatthasaṃyato. dutiyapade'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: hatthasaṃyato pādasaṃyato, vācāsaṃyato saṃyat'uttamo, ajjhattarato samāhito, eko santusito tam'āhu bhikkhuṃ.

74042.meaning1: causing to play; allowing to play

examples.text: hatthasaṃyato pādasaṃyato, vācāsaṃyato saṃyat'uttamo, ajjhattarato samāhito, eko santusito tam'āhu bhikkhuṃ.

74044.commentary: (DHPa) vācāya pana musāvād'ādīnaṃ akaraṇato vācāya saṃyato.

examples.text: hatthasaṃyato pādasaṃyato, vācāsaṃyato saṃyat'uttamo, ajjhattarato samāhito, eko santusito tam'āhu bhikkhuṃ.
hatthasaṃyato pādasaṃyato, vācāsaṃyato saṃyat'uttamo, ajjhattarato samāhito, eko santusito tam'āhu bhikkhuṃ.

74046.meaning1: clean mode of living; pure in livelihood
74046.commentary: (DHPa) taṃ ve'ti taṃ evarūpaṃ bhikkhuṃ sārajīvitatāya suddhājīviṃ jaṅghabalaṃ nissāya jīvitakappanena akusītatāya atanditaṃ devā pasaṃsanti thomentī'ti attho.

examples.text: appalābho'pi ce bhikkhu, salābhaṃ n'ātimaññati, taṃ ve devā pasaṃsanti, suddh'ājīviṃ atanditaṃ.

74047.meaning1: with a (certain kind of) livelihood; with a (certain) mode of living; having a (certain) way of life

examples.text: appalābho'pi ce bhikkhu, salābhaṃ n'ātimaññati, taṃ ve devā pasaṃsanti, suddh'ājīviṃ atanditaṃ.

74048.commentary: (DHPa) sittā te lahum'essatī'ti yathā hi mahāsamudde udakass'eva bharitā nāvā chiddāni pidahitvā udakassa sittatāya sittā sallahukā hutvā mahāsamudde anosīditvā sīghaṃ supaṭṭanaṃ gacchati, evaṃ tavā'pi ayaṃ micchāvitakk'odakabharitā attabhāvanā'vā cakkhudvār'ādichiddāni saṃvarena pidahitvā uppannassa micchāvitakk'odakassa sittatāya sittā sallahukā saṃsāravaṭṭe anosīditvā sīghaṃ nibbānaṃ gamissati.

examples.text: siñca bhikkhu imaṃ nāvaṃ, sittā te lahum'essati, chetvā rāgañ'ca dosañ'ca, tato nibbānam'ehisi.

74049.commentary: (DHPa) sittā te lahum'essatī'ti yathā hi mahāsamudde udakass'eva bharitā nāvā chiddāni pidahitvā udakassa sittatāya sittā sallahukā hutvā mahāsamudde anosīditvā sīghaṃ supaṭṭanaṃ gacchati, evaṃ tavā'pi ayaṃ micchāvitakk'odakabharitā attabhāvanā'vā cakkhudvār'ādichiddāni saṃvarena pidahitvā uppannassa micchāvitakk'odakassa sittatāya sittā sallahukā saṃsāravaṭṭe anosīditvā sīghaṃ nibbānaṃ gamissati.

examples.text: siñca bhikkhu imaṃ nāvaṃ, sittā te lahum'essati, chetvā rāgañ'ca dosañ'ca, tato nibbānam'ehisi.
n'atthi jhānaṃ apaññassa, paññā n'atthi ajjhāyino, yamhi jhānañ'ca paññā ca, sa ve nibbānasantike.
vassikā viya pupphāni, maddavāni pamuñcati, evaṃ rāgañ'ca dosañ'ca, vippamuñcetha bhikkhavo.
paṃsukūladharaṃ jantuṃ, kisaṃ dhamanisanthataṃ, ekaṃ vanasmiṃ jhāyantaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

74054.meaning1: mastering everything to be mastered; perfecting everything to be perfected
74054.commentary: (DHPa) yo… abhiññeyyaṃ dhammaṃ abhijānitvā pariññeyyaṃ parijānitvā pahātabbaṃ pahāya sacchikātabbaṃ sacchikatvā vosiko niṭṭhānaṃ patto, vusitavosānaṃ vā patto, āsavakkhayapaññāya monabhāvaṃ pattattā muni, tam'ahaṃ sabbesaṃ kilesānaṃ vosānaṃ arahattamaggañāṇaṃ brahmacariyavāsaṃ vutthabhāvena sabbavositavosānaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vadāmī'ti.

examples.text: pubbenivāsaṃ yo vedi, sagg'āpāyañ'ca passati atho jātikkhayaṃ patto, abhiññāvosito muni, sabbavositavosānaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

74055.meaning1: containing one hundred; consisting of a hundred

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhante, nānāpupphānaṃ mahāpuppharāsi, tam'enaṃ dakkho mālākāro vā mālākār'antevāsī vā vicittaṃ mālaṃ gantheyya, evam'eva kho, bhante, so bhagavā anekavaṇṇo anekasatavaṇṇo.

74057.grammar: card, fem sg, comp, abbrev of ekacattālīsā

74059.commentary: (UDa) atha yā paccayanirodhassa sammā aviditattā uppajjeyyuṃ pubbe vuttappabhedā kaṅkhā, tā sabbā'pi vapayanti nirujjhantī'ti.

examples.text: yadā have pātubhavanti dhammā, ātāpino jhāyato brāhmaṇassa, ath'assa kaṅkhā vapayanti sabbā, yato pajānāti sahetudhamman'ti.

74060.meaning1: phenomenon and its cause; causal nature of a thing
74060.commentary: (UDa) kasmā? yato pajānāti sahetudhammaṃ, yasmā avijj'ādikena hetunā sahetukaṃ imaṃ saṅkhār'ādikaṃ kevalaṃ dukkhakkhandhadhammaṃ pajānāti aññāsi paṭivijjhī'ti.

examples.text: yadā have pātubhavanti dhammā, ātāpino jhāyato brāhmaṇassa, ath'assa kaṅkhā vapayanti sabbā, yato pajānāti sahetudhamman'ti.

74061.commentary: (UDa) huṃhuṅkajātiko'ti so kira diṭṭhamaṅgaliko mānathaddho mānavasena kodhavasena ca sabbaṃ avokkhajātikaṃ passitvā jigucchanto huṃhun'ti karonto vicarati, tasmā huṃhuṅkajātiko'ti vuccati, huhukkajātiko'ti'pi pāṭho.

examples.text: atha kho aññataro huṃhuṅkajātiko brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi. sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhāsi.

74067.meaning1: the statement 'I am a Brahman'; the assertion of being a Brahman
74067.commentary: (NPa) dhammena so brahmavādaṃ vadeyyā'ti so brāhmaṇo ahan'ti etaṃ vādaṃ vadeyya. (NPt) so brāhmaṇo brahmavādaṃ ahaṃ brāhmaṇo'mhī'ti vācaṃ vadeyyā'ti bhagavā avocā'ti yojanā.
74067.notes: In Vedānta, this is the assertion that all things are Brahma.

examples.text: yo brāhmaṇo bāhitapāpadhammo, nihuṃhuṅko nikkasāvo yat'atto, ved'antagū vūsitabrahmacariyo, dhammena so brahmavādaṃ vadeyya, yass'ussadā n'atthi kuhiñci loke'ti.

74068.meaning1: of Brahman birth; from a Brahman family
74068.commentary: (UDa) brāhmaṇajātiko'ti brāhmaṇakule jāto. so hi uḷārabhogā brāhmaṇamahāsālakulā pabbajito. tassa kira evaṃ ahosi ime lokiyā ubhatosujātiyā brāhmaṇasikkhānipphattiyā ca brāhmaṇo hoti, na aññathā'ti vadanti, bhagavā ca ete āyasmante brāhmaṇā'ti vadati, hand'āhaṃ bhagavantaṃ brāhmaṇalakkhaṇaṃ puccheyyan'ti etadattham'eva hi bhagavā tadā te there brāhmaṇā'ti abhāsi. brahmaṃ aṇatī'ti brāhmaṇo'ti hi jātibrāhmaṇānaṃ nibbacanaṃ.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, aññataro brāhmaṇajātiko bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, brāhmaṇo hoti, katame ca pana brāhmaṇakaraṇā dhammā'ti?

74069.commentary: (UDa) pippaliguhāyan'ti tassā kira guhāya dvārasamīpe eko pippalirukkho ahosi, tena sā pippaliguhā'ti paññāyittha.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe. tena kho pana samayena āyasmā mahākassapo pipphaliguhāyaṃ viharati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
tena kho pana samayena pañcamattāni devatāsatāni ussukkaṃ āpannāni honti āyasmato mahākassapassa piṇḍapātapaṭilābhāya.

74074.commentary: (UDa) ajakalāpake cetiye'ti ajakalāpakena nāma yakkhena pariggahitattā ajakalāpakan'ti laddhanāme manussānaṃ cittīkataṭṭhāne. so kira yakkho aje kalāpe katvā bandhanena ajakoṭṭhāsena saddhiṃ baliṃ paṭicchati, na aññathā, tasmā ajakalāpako'ti paññāyittha. keci pan'āhu, ajake viya satte lāpetī'ti ajakalāpako'ti. tassa kira sattā baliṃ upanetvā yadā ajasaddaṃ katvā baliṃ upaharanti, tadā so tussati, tasmā ajakalāpako'ti vuccatī'ti.
